description: This file declares functions related to handling controller metrics in the Map control module for a wireless network system. It includes function prototypes for updating station link metrics and querying link metrics periodically.

methods.name: map_update_assoc_sta_link_metrics
methods.description: Updates the link metrics for an associated station in the wireless network.

methods.name: map_periodic_link_metric_query_timer_cb
methods.description: Callback function for the periodic link metric query timer.
